hypothesis.falsification: In a later preregistered diagnostic, reject the practical warmup prediction if four versus one warmup does not reduce subsequent prefill time by the proposed 10%, or causes quality/resource failure. Reject the specific file-residency explanation if valid counters show no reduction in measured physical IO/fault demand despite a timing improvement; investigate initialization instead, without relabeling it a residency win. Missing counters, unequal effective configs, invalid A/A, cache carryover/order imbalance or incomplete runs make the mechanism inconclusive, not supported. Do not infer convergence after four requests and do not rescore the historical 256/512 comparison.
hypothesis.mechanism: The pinned Strata chunk256 layer-major path on the larger-than-memory DeepSeek pack may require repeated identical pp512/tg128 requests to populate reusable file-backed expert pages in GB10 shared CPU/GPU DRAM. One discarded request may leave a transient prefill working set. Four fixed premeasurement requests may lower subsequent physical read/fault demand and prefill time without changing routing, arithmetic, chunk size or cache capacity. This causal explanation competes with lazy runtime initialization and scheduling effects; timing alone cannot establish it.
hypothesis.prediction: At fixed effective chunk256 and dspark none, the same next three pp512/tg128 measured requests after four warmups will have lower pooled native prefill time than after one warmup in independently counterbalanced fresh-process blocks. Proposed diagnostic effect threshold: at least 10% prefill-time reduction, with lower physical read bytes or major faults per measured prompt token and stable expert placement/memory headroom. Decode and combined native rates are reported independently. Threshold is a proposed falsifier, not an acceptance gate, and must be frozen before any later run; it does not imply a predicted deployable speedup.
required_counters: Per-request native prefill_ms, decode_ms, generated and prompt token counts; exact request position including every discarded warmup and the same next three measured requests.
Per-request or phase-aligned process physical read_bytes, major/minor faults, OS cached/file-backed memory; logical read counts must not stand in for physical SSD reads.
Effective native chunk256, DS4_CHUNK/DS4_WINDOWS state, dspark none and zero offered/accepted drafts; unchanged prefix reuse, full-six routing and static cache configuration.
Expert resident/read-in-place counts and bytes, placement changes, explicit copy bytes and waits where available; distinguish missing from zero.
OS available memory, CUDA free memory (not a substitute for reclaimable page cache), peak cgroup memory, OOM events and unchanged host reserve; CPU/GPU utilization, clock/thermal and background load.
Immutable image/build/source/model/tokenizer/profile identities; complete raw streams, canonical outputs/finish reasons, cleanup and observer completeness/overhead.

design_clarifications.interpretation: Even if later supported, this is evidence of workload warmup sensitivity, not a deployable engine speedup. It would motivate a separate frozen steady-state chunk comparison, not rescore the retained main report.
design_clarifications.observer_gap: DS4_PROF has a retained unresolved crash. Do not enable it to obtain these counters without independent lifecycle validation under later authority. If safe physical IO/placement counters are unavailable, mark mechanism unresolved; traced timing cannot score.
design_clarifications.protocol: Independent A/A validity first; later frozen fresh-process ABBA diagnostic, at most three trials; request sequence fixed except warmup count. Freeze common warmup contents and all controls, with warmup count explicitly the sole exception to the generic cache/warmup freeze. Retain per-position data; no selective discards or convergence stopping. Report order/cache carryover and time spent warming. Four warmups do not establish steady state.

A/B combined 9.20195/10.70048 output tokens/s; prefill 101.557/180.569 input tokens/s; decode 14.43296/14.02494 output tokens/s. Quality 60/64 per cell, no sampled per-question regression, valid answers, drafts disabled. Small-N, sampled-quality and native-only scope preclude population, startup or end-to-end claims.
Pilot quality 2/2 both arms and combined rates 9.5115/10.6496; performance acceptance explicitly not evaluated. Pilot is not independent confirmation of a performance gate.

Post-hoc measured-position combined ratios 1.27067,1.12536,1.09180, while first discarded request ratio 1.01023. Chunk256 prefill improves across positions; chunk512 near stable. Cannot infer mechanism, convergence, cold SSD or revise one-discard historical analysis.

Paper results do not transfer to shared-DRAM GB10 or this quantized DeepSeek pack. Pre-gating changes routing/model and remains outside runtime scope.

decisions.uncertainty: No new experiment was performed. Warmup causality, convergence, independent A/A validity and safe counter availability remain unresolved. Alternative lazy initialization, scheduling, cache carryover and shared bandwidth explanations remain open. Failed profiling cannot resolve them. A supported warmup diagnostic would establish protocol sensitivity, not an engine optimization or revised historical verdict.

decisions.stop_condition: Terminal now. No execution or promotion; later frozen template required. Stop any future experiment on A/A/quality/resource/engagement/evidence failure under that template.
decisions.reason_for_change: The measured-position drift in warmup-diagnostic directly motivates this one diagnostic before implementing research-candidates. Isolating warmup count can distinguish residual protocol transients from a stable operating regime and test a concrete file-residency explanation with counters. Stacking prefetch, prediction, CPU scheduling and drafting would alter shared-DRAM pressure and several mechanisms simultaneously, obscure attribution and inherit missing engagement evidence. benchmark-secondary-metrics already demonstrates that a decode gain can reduce combined throughput. Preserve prefill-main-report's scoped acceptance and native-profile-failure unchanged; this report is inconclusive about any new gain.
